Description

Sleek and Low Profile

With an ultra-slim 61mm/2.4" body, Air 1 sits naturally under clothing for a polished, less bulky look. It’s designed for mums who want pumping to feel more discreet during workdays, commuting, travel, and social outings.

Includes Wireless Charging

The wireless charging case supports up to 15 pumping sessions, about 30 minutes each, making Air 1 ready to go on busy days. Spend less time stopping to recharge and more time doing the things that matter.

Transparent Design for Alignment

The transparent 'top-view' design helps you align faster, while clear markings let you see milk output at a glance. When you’re pumping away from home or in the middle of a busy day, that extra visibility brings more confidence and fewer repeated adjustments.

Smart Pumping. More Control.

Air 1 goes beyond basic app control with sensor-enabled features like Auto Mode Switching, Milk Tracking, and Full Collector Alerts. You stay more informed throughout each session – without constantly checking, guessing, or interrupting your flow.

Generous 6oz Capacity. Slim Profile.

The 6oz collector gives you more space for milk without adding bulk. Air 1 is built to balance low-profile wear with real-life pumping needs, making it a strong fit for daily use, longer outings, and other outside home sessions.

Important Notes

Pour After Removing the Pump Motor
After pumping, detach the motor from the milk collector before pouring out milk.

Full-Collector Auto Stop Is Enabled by Default
Air 1 automatically stops pumping when the milk collector is full. If your pump stops unexpectedly, please check the full-collector setting in the Momcozy App.

Safety Warning

Do NOT use this device if you have a cardiac pacemaker, implanted defibrillator, or any other metallic or electronic implant, as it may cause electromagnetic interference or serious injury.

Key Features & Benefits

· Ultra-Slim & Discreet – Just 2.4 inches thin, 20% slimmer than other conventional pumps for ultimate privacy.

· Transparent Top for Quick Alignment – The industry-first design enables easy nipple alignment and instant milk checks.

· Wireless Charging Convenience – Delivers up to 5 days of use or 15 pumping sessions.

· Smart App Control & Auto Tracking – Connects to the Momcozy app for automatic mode switching, real-time milk tracking, and full collector alerts.

· Soft, Comfortable Fit – 50A silicone flanges provide gentle, secure comfort for all breast shapes.

· Easy to Clean – Only 5 parts to wash, with a durable PPSU collector for simple, hygienic care.

Need Replacement Parts?

Replacement parts for the Air 1 Ultra-Slim Pump are now available for purchase through the Momcozy App. Please check the App for details and purchase links.

FAQs

What is an ultra slim breast pump?

An ultra slim breast pump is a wearable, in-bra cup with a thinner profile than a typical all-in-one, so it sits flatter under clothes. Air 1 is 61 mm — built for UK mums who express at work or away from home and do not want a bulky outline. A slim breast pump is about how it sits, not about being the quietest motor.

What makes Air 1 different from other slim wearable breast pumps?

Air 1 is Momcozy’s slimmest all-in-one wearable at 61 mm, about 22% slimmer than M9. You get a transparent top to centre the nipple, a 180 ml collector, and a charging case for up to 15 sessions. Choose it when a lower in-bra profile is the job. If a quieter motor matters more than how slim the cup sits, M9 is the better match.

Is the Air 1 ultra slim breast pump good for pumping at work?

Yes. That is the job it is built for. The 61 mm cup sits in a nursing bra under work clothes, so you can keep
pumping at work
without a bulky outline. The charging case covers a run of sessions away from a plug. If a shared room means noise matters more than profile, choose M9.

Is the Momcozy Air 1 easy to use for first-time mums?

Yes. The transparent top lets you see the nipple is centred before you start — usually the hardest step on a wearable. There are five parts to wash, buttons on the cup, and the app only if you want it. You can express without opening your phone.

How do I use the Air 1 ultra-slim breast pump?

Wash and assemble the five milk-contact parts. Keep the motor dry.

Place the cup in your bra. Use the transparent top to centre the nipple in the tunnel.

Turn on. Choose Stimulation, Expression or Mixed on the cup or in the app, then pick a suction level that feels comfortable — not the highest.

When the 180 ml collector is full, the app can alert you. Switch off, take the motor off, then pour.

How do I centre the flange on the Air 1?

Look through the transparent top and check the nipple sits in the middle of the tunnel, not pulled to one side. Measure nipple diameter, not bra cup. Air 1 ships with a 24 mm flange and 17/19/21 mm inserts. Pain, a white ring, or too much areola being pulled in means resize before you turn suction up.

Can I track expressing sessions and milk volume?

Yes. The Momcozy app can switch modes, show milk volume as you go, alert you when the collector is full, and keep a session history. The pump still runs from the buttons on the cup if you would rather not use the phone.

How long does the Air 1 charging case last?

The case holds enough power for up to 15 sessions of about 30 minutes. Seat each pump so the contacts line up; the case tops them up and stores them for a work day or a few days out. Charge the case from a plug at home, then take it with you.

How do I clean and sterilise the Air 1 ultra-slim breast pump?

Take the motor off first and wipe it dry only — never soak it. Rinse the five milk-contact parts (collector, back cover, flange, valve, diaphragm) straight after use, wash in warm soapy water, then sterilise with steam or a cold-water method. Air-dry fully before you assemble.
